name: Rasabali
instructions: 1. Knead the chhena with semolina until smooth and form small, flattened round patties.
2. Deep-fry the patties in ghee until they turn golden brown.
3. In a separate heavy-bottomed pan, boil the milk until it reduces to half its volume.
4. Add sugar, cardamom powder, and saffron to the thickened milk.
5. Gently drop the fried patties into the simmering milk and let them soak for at least an hour before serving.
description: Rasabali is a traditional Odia sweet dish, famously offered as a bhog to Lord Baladevjew at the Baladevjew Temple in Kendrapara. It is one of the iconic Chhappan Bhog (56 offerings) associated with Odisha's rich culinary heritage.
